_doc: Player weapon handling (src/weapons.cpp stepWeapons). Dispersion: each shot leaves inside a cone of half-angle hip[class] or ads[class] (deg, ADS = adsT > 0.85; the sight-line path uses the same draw) x stance[stance]. Stance, first match wins: mounted (bipod deployed: a bipod weapon, prone or crouched, still), prone, crouched, sprinting (moving with Shift, not aiming), moving, standing (still). Recoil per shot: the weapon's own profile x recoil[stance] x 0.85 in ADS; mounted = recoil[prone or crouched] x the weapon's recoil.supported (its bipod factor), recoil.mounted only for a bipod weapon without one; standing still kicks pitch only, moving (any stance) adds movingYaw of the weapon's horizontal wander. classes: weapon id -> rifle / sniper / auto / lmg (unlisted: scope -> sniper, belt -> lmg, auto -> auto, else rifle). Bots keep their own aim model (content/ai).
